step1_broad_independent_seed_sweep.description: bounded_tanh: 300 NEW configs (seeds 50-64, disjoint from the original discovery seeds 0-14; same 4 topologies x 5 asymmetry_strengths as the original sweep). sinusoidal: smaller control sweep (same 15 new seeds x 4 topologies, strength=0.3 only, 60 configs), kept as a control per review's instruction (Kuramoto association), not the main axis.

step2_hit_vs_nohit_structural_comparison.description: Pooled all covered-cycle checks from BOTH the original discovery sweep (PR-R3) and this PR's broad independent sweep -- 788 total, 2 smooth (both are the SAME seed=9 cycle, checked under 2 forms), 786 non-smooth. Compared mean/min node degree, cycle length, and max_adjacent_step. Also checked run-level persistence density (fraction of the 24 nodes verified) and internal-chord density specifically for the one hit.
step2_hit_vs_nohit_structural_comparison.conclusion: Neither raw node degree, nor run-level full-graph persistence density, nor internal chord density reliably distinguishes the one hit from the broader population -- the density=1.0 hypothesis (suggested by the hit itself) did NOT replicate against 7 other density=1.0 runs (0/72 of their covered cycles were smooth, several with especially large max_adjacent_step). No validated structural predictor was found this PR.

step3_r8_instrument.reason: Review's explicit condition (multiple independent graphs showing passing cycles) was not met -- the broad sweep found 0 new smoothness-gate-passing cycles across 284 new covered-cycle checks.

step4_fourth_coupling_form.reason: Explicitly lower priority than steps 1-2 per review's instruction; deferred given steps 1-2's findings (a null broad-sweep result) took priority for this PR's compute budget.

totals_across_all_R_layer_winding_invest.note: The 1 hit was independently confirmed under 2 coupling forms (2 of the 788 checks), on the SAME underlying graph -- so exactly 1 unique location in 133 unique graphs checked, across two full PR rounds of investigation.
